name: City of Santa Monica
disclaimer: Santa Monica has additional coastal and design review requirements. Verify with Santa Monica Planning & Community Development.

notes: Santa Monica is entirely within the Coastal Zone — most ADUs require a Coastal Development Permit (CDP).
State law streamlines ADU approvals but coastal CDP adds review layer.
Rent control ordinance may affect ADU rental terms.
Alley-loaded lots common — rear setback may be measured from alley centerline.

coastal.note: All of Santa Monica is in the CA Coastal Zone. A Coastal Development Permit is required in addition to standard building permits.
